data.title: Canadian Retail Sales Indicate Central Bank Can Be Patient — Market Talk
data.description: A modest rise in core Canadian retail sales in September and an advance estimate for a sizeable decline in October sales supports Capital Economics' view the Bank of Canada has scope to wait until the New Year to lift interest rates again. That is especially the case with oil prices at their lowest in almost three months, economist Bradley Saunders says. Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") is planning to acquire 100% equity of Uniwatt Technology Co., Ltd. through the issuance of shares and cash payment and to raise supporting funds, which constitutes a related-party transaction (hereinafter referred to as "the Transaction"). According to the Administrative Measures for the Major Asset Restructuring of Listed Companies and other relevant regulations, the Transaction constitutes a related-party transaction but is not expected to constitute a major asset restructuring.

II. Progress of the Transaction

In accordance with the relevant regulations of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the trading of the Company's A share stock (stock abbreviation: MYSE, stock code: 601615) has been suspended from the opening of the market on January 13, 2026 (Tuesday, Beijing Time). The suspension lasts for no more than 10 trading days. For details, please refer to the Announcement on Trading Suspension in Respect of the Proposed Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions disclosed by the Company on January 13, 2026.

On January 22, 2026, the Company held the 30th meeting of the third Board, at which the Proposal on the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and other proposals related to the Transaction were reviewed and approved. For details, please refer to the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and other relevant announcements disclosed by the Company on January 22, 2026.

Upon application to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the trading of the Company's A share stock (stock abbreviation: MYSE, stock code: 601615) was resumed from the market opening on Friday, January 23, 2026. For details, please refer to the Announcement on General Risk Warning Regarding the Disclosure of the Restructuring Proposal and the Resumption of Trading of the Company's Stock disclosed by the Company on January 22, 2026.

On January 23, 2026, the Company received the Inquiry Letter on the Information Disclosure of the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition (SZGH [2026] No. 0129) (hereinafter referred to as the "Inquiry Letter") from the Listed Company Management Department I of the Shanghai Stock Exchange. In accordance with the Inquiry Letter, the Company has organized relevant parties to conduct careful verification, analysis, and research on the related matters, and has implemented and responded to them item by item. Meanwhile, the Company has revised, supplemented, and disclosed the Proposal on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited in accordance with the requirements of the Inquiry Letter and the relevant replies, which are marked in bold italic. For details, please refer to the Announcement on the Reply to the Inquiry Letter from the Shanghai Stock Exchange Regarding the Information Disclosure of the Proposal on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition and the Proposal of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions (Revised Version) disclosed by the Company on February 5, 2026.

Since the disclosure of the proposal for the Transaction, the Company and all relevant parties have been actively advancing the work related to the Transaction. On February 23, March 23, April 22, May 22 and June 22, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transaction.

Since it was anticipated that the notice for convening the Shareholders' Meeting could not be issued within six months after the announcement date of the Board's resolution for the initial review of the Transaction, the Company disclosed the Special Explanation on the Progress of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions and the Failure to Issue a Notice Convening a Shareholders' Meeting Within the Prescribed Time Limit on July 22, 2026.

On August 21, September 22 and October 22, 2026, the Company disclosed the Announcement of Ming Yang Smart Energy Group Limited on Progress of Matter in Respect of the Issuance of Shares and Cash Payment for Asset Acquisition, Raising of Supporting Funds and Related-Party Transactions.

As of the disclosure date of this Announcement, the relevant due diligence, audit, evaluation and other work have not yet been completed. Recently, the development stage of the downstream industry of the Target Company has undergone certain changes compared with the initial planning phase, and the Company and the relevant parties have engaged in renewed deliberations and negotiations on the core terms such as the transaction consideration, and have not yet reached a consensus. The Company will continue to work with relevant intermediary agencies to prudently evaluate the feasibility of continuing to advance the Transaction, and there is a possibility of major adjustments to or even termination of the transaction proposal. The Company will perform the relevant decision-making and approval procedures and information disclosure obligations in strict accordance with the relevant laws and regulations based on the progress of the Transaction.

III. Risk Warning

1. The Transaction is still in the planning stage, the relevant due diligence, audit, evaluation and other work have not yet been completed, the parties to the Transaction have not yet signed a formal transaction agreement, and all parties still need to perform the necessary internal and external decision-making and approval procedures, and there is a risk that it may not be approved through the relevant decision-making and approval procedures.

2. Since the planning of this transaction, the downstream industry of the target company has evolved in its development stage relative to the initial planning phase. The Company and all relevant parties have re-evaluated and renegotiated the core terms, including the transaction consideration, but have yet to reach a consensus. As a result, the transaction is subject to the risk of material adjustment to its structure and material uncertainty as to its continuation.

3. There is still uncertainty as to whether the Transaction can be finally implemented. WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - A massive negative sentiment in Wall Street, triggered by renewed worries about the artificial intelligence trade has spilled over to the cryptocurrency market. Worries about high interest rates, the massive outflows from U.S.-listed Bitcoin Spot ETF products as well as the heavy liquidation of crypto long positions abetted the decline. Overall crypto market capitalization has dropped 3.3 percent overnight to $2.11 trillion.

The CMC Crypto Fear and Greed Index which measures the overall sentiment in the crypto market is remaining at 10, denoting extreme fear.

With the enthusiasm surrounding Anthropic's IPO fading, Wall Street indexes are trading on a weak note. The Dow Jones is currently trading 0.19 percent higher at 49,189.19. The S&P 500 is trading 0.48 percent lower at 7,141.23. The Nasdaq Composite is trading 1.4 percent lower at 23,536.07.

Cryptocurrency markets witnessed a massive jump in liquidations. Aggregate liquidations during the 24-hour period stood at $818 million versus $363 million a day earlier. Liquidation of long positions increased to $713 million from $253 million a day earlier. Liquidation of short positions decreased to $105 million from $110 million a day earlier. Amidst the liquidation cascade, the overall cryptocurrency market capitalization has dropped to $2.11 trillion.

Markets continue to expect a quarter percent rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December. The probability of a quarter percent rate hike has increased to 95.8 percent from 93.9 percent a day earlier. Meanwhile, expectations of a half percent Fed rate hike in December have dropped to nil from 6.1 percent a day earlier and the likelihood of a status quo on rates has increased to 4.2 percent from nil a day earlier.

The dollar's retreat on Thursday limited losses in the crypto market sentiment. The six-currency Dollar Index which measures the Dollar's strength against a basket of 6 currencies is currently trading at 103.71, slipping 0.18 percent overnight.

Bitcoin (BTC), the largest cryptocurrency is currently trading 3.1 percent lower on an overnight basis at $61,886.34. Bitcoin is saddled with losses of 10.5 percent in the past week. Bitcoin traded between $63,981.13 and $61,196.31 during the past 24 hours.

6th ranked XRP (XRP), a payments-focused cryptocurrency also erased 4.1 percent overnight. Weekly losses amount to 7.8 percent. XRP is currently trading at $0.9496.

The price of 7th ranked Solana (SOL) declined 4.9 percent overnight to $71.34. SOL has slipped 12.2 percent in the past week. U.S.-listed Solana Spot ETF products witnessed outflows of $1 million on Thursday versus nil flows on Wednesday.
